newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish 98 zloty devaluation 7-10 pct -budget draft.
newsitem.headline: Polish 98 zloty devaluation 7-10 pct -budget draft.

text.p: Poland's 1998 budget draft assumes that the zloty would be devalued by seven to 10 percent as a result of the monthly crawling devaluation mechanism and moves within the trading band, the finance minister said.
"We expect the zloty would be devalued by seven to 10 percent nominally as a result of the crawling peg and exchange rate swings within the band," Marek Belka told journalists on Wednesday.
Under the budget law for this year the zloty was to be devalued by nine percent as a result of the crawling peg mechanism alone.
But the monthly rate of one percent against a basket of currencies has not been changed since the start of the year and Poland's efforts to support exports make a near-term cut in the rate unlikely.
